title: The new app icon — the purple mascot

steps.path: The Start menu, desktop shortcut, taskbar, Dock and app list, once YouCoded is installed
steps.headline: Which pose should the purple mascot hold in the app icon?
steps.notice: Every picture is the app's own mascot in its real pose, in plain purple with no theme, on the lavender tile. Each is shown big and at the sizes Windows really uses. Your installer pick, the purple strip with an arrow, gets rebuilt around whichever you choose.
steps.risk: At the smallest size (the tiny one) any mascot turns into a purple blob; that one size could use the simple robot outline instead.

variants.label: Resting
variants.summary: Arms down, big friendly eyes and a small smile. The calmest and the easiest to read small.

variants.label: Waving
variants.summary: One arm raised in the wave the mascot does when you open the app.
variants.risk: The raised arm floats a little away from the body, the same as it does in the app.

variants.label: Cheering
variants.summary: Both arms up with happy closed eyes. The most cheerful, and the widest shape.
variants.risk: Both arms float away from the body, so at small sizes it reads as three separate blocks.

variants.label: Curious
variants.summary: Arms down, one eyebrow raised and a small round mouth. Has the most personality at full size.
variants.risk: The eyebrow disappears below the biggest size.

steps.path: The Start menu, desktop shortcut, taskbar, Dock and app list, once YouCoded is installed
steps.headline: Which mascot style should the app icon use?
steps.notice: Both are shown in the resting pose; the pose you pick above applies to either.

variants.label: Soft 3D
variants.summary: The app's default mascot: soft shading and a shine on the body, exactly as it appears inside YouCoded.

variants.label: Sticker
variants.summary: The same mascot with a thin white die-cut border around every part. Stands out more against the lavender tile.
variants.risk: It is not the look the mascot has inside the app, where the default is Soft 3D.
